analogy.rationale: OXTR and related AVPR receptors are G protein-coupled receptors with negligible expression in most of these cell lines, so oxytocin receptor antagonists should elicit little transcriptional response. Other GPCR antagonists, especially those targeting receptors poorly expressed in these cells, are expected to behave similarly.
